title: "EDA"
format: html
---

1. Load packages and data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(janitor)
library(GGally)
library(scales)
```

```{r}
accessibility_raw_lga <- read_csv(
  "clean_data/accessibility_raw_lga.csv"
)

health_lga <- read_csv(
  "clean_data/health_lga.csv"
)

lga <- st_read(
  "data/lga/LGA_POLYGON.shp",
  quiet = TRUE
)
```

2. Prepare analysis dataset
```{r}
# Check LGA names
accessibility_raw_lga |>
  summarise(
    n_lgas = n(),
    n_unique_lgas = n_distinct(LGA_CODE)
  )

health_lga |>
  summarise(
    n_lgas = n(),
    n_unique_lgas = n_distinct(LGA_NAME)
  )

analysis_lga <- accessibility_raw_lga |>
  left_join(
    health_lga,
    by = "LGA_NAME"
  )
```

```{r}
analysis_lga |>
  summarise(
    n_lgas = n(),
    missing_health = sum(is.na(poor_health_percent)),
    missing_obesity = sum(is.na(obesity_percent)),
    missing_distress = sum(is.na(distress_percent))
  )
```
